verdict.rationale: Kit's own features include background automation: the pricing page lists "Unlimited Visual Automations" and RSS campaigns, and the API can schedule broadcasts to send later. The Kit MCP lets AI clients act on subscribers, sequences and broadcasts, but the evidence never shows an AI setting up or running autonomous automation workflows. Automations themselves appear only as single-line marketing bullets. missing for 10: documented detail on how visual automations are built, triggered and run; evidence that automations can be created or managed via the API or MCP; independent or hands-on corroboration.
